monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple BGP UPDATE withdraws observed for a PrivateLink attachment (pl-attach-06) in eu-west-2 AZ-b. Flap count > 12 in last 5m, packet loss spike on path to customer VPC. Correlating metrics: bgp.updates, route-withdraw.

oncall-net: paging @alex (net oncall) — you up? this is hitting AcmeCorp PrivateLink traffic, customer-facing.

alex: ack — looking. seeing withdrawals from our Route Reflector pool (rr-euw2-01/02). CPU ok, but control-plane shows repeated prefix churn for 10.10.200.0/24 -> Acme VPC.

sasha: customer impact? any session resets on the tunnel side? @cust-eng-acme can you confirm observed symptoms from Acme side?

cust-eng-acme: seeing 50-80% TLS session errors to our webhook endpoints in eu-west-2 for the last ~6m. They pointed us here. No config changes on our side.

lee: quick checks done: traceroute from edge->peer shows alternating next-hops. Looks like RR is bouncing routes between two eBGP peers causing asymmetric paths. Loss spikes align with withdraws. pulling bgp summary now.

alex: paste: ```
# show bgp summary | match 10.10.200.0
Neighbor        AS    MsgRcvd MsgSent  TblVer  Up/Down  State/PfxRcd
192.0.2.45    64512   12345   12340      320   00:04:12     1
198.51.100.12 64513   12346   12341      321   00:04:10     0 (prefix withdrawn)
```

maria: I'm seeing config drift on rr-euw2-02 — a maintenance change last night added an export-policy that accidentally tags the Acme prefix with local-preference toggles. Rolling back to staged config now.

devops-bot: deploy-job #ci/rr-config-rollback started on rr-euw2-02 (job 8842). Logs: applying policy rollback.

maria: rollback applied, restarting bgp on rr-euw2-02 to clear session, will monitor. ```
sudo systemctl restart bgp
journalctl -u bgp -n 200
```

alex: good call. I'm injecting a temporary route-map on the edge peers to prefer rr-euw2-01 while we validate: ```
route-map PREFER-RR permit 10
 set local-preference 220
``` applying to neighbor 198.51.100.12 out.

sasha: @cust-eng-acme any immediate change on your side?

cust-eng-acme: slight improvement now, errors down to ~10% in the last 2m. still seeing occasional 502s.

lee: monitoring telemetry — BGP withdraws dropped to 0 after the rollback + route-map. Latency normalized for most flows. I'll keep guard for 30m.

oncall-net: updating incident doc and pinging provider NOC to confirm there was no flapping on their side. escalation ticket created: NOC-70821.

devops-bot: deploy-job #ci/rr-config-rollback completed SUCCESS on rr-euw2-02 (duration 01:24). Changeset: revert export-policy-acme. CI diff: -community-set, -localpref-toggle.

alex: handoff in 30m to @lee for monitoring window. Summary for next oncall: cause = accidental export-policy change on rr-euw2-02 causing pref toggles -> repeated withdraws; mitigation = rollback config, temporary local-pref on edge peers, monitor. Customer impact: Acme experienced TLS errors and 5xxs for ~6–12m. Remediation: provider NOC ticket open, config audit scheduled.

lee: taking over at 23:15 UTC. will run full route consistency checks across RR pool and validate BGP update rates. also will WARN in runbook to avoid export-policy edits without two-step review in euw2 RRs.

sasha: sending customer update draft: "We detected and mitigated a routing config regression in our eu-west-2 routing plane that caused transient connectivity errors to your PrivateLink endpoints. The issue has been rolled back and services are now stable. We will follow up with a post-incident summary and preventive actions." Please review @cust-eng-acme.

cust-eng-acme: message looks good, thanks for the quick mitigation. we'll validate from our side and reopen if anything persists.

maria: adding to postmortem: attach config diff + timestamps + who approved last night's maintenance (auto-approved by pipeline). Also syncing with infra change control to block risky export-policy edits during business hours.

oncall-net: closing paging window; severity -> sev2 (customer-impact reduced). tagging incident for postmortem and SLA review.

monitoring-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT 2992233445 status=mitigated severity=sev2 impacted_customers=[AcmeCorp] start=2992233445 mitigated=2992234510 notes="config rollback + temporary localpref"
